command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo

if(& git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/definitely-missing-flyexplorer-ref"){
  throw "unexpected existing ref"
}
Write-Host "HANDLED_EXPECTED_NATIVE_NONZERO=PASS"

$bare='& cmd /c exit 7'
& powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command $bare
$bareCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host "BARE_NATIVE_FAILURE_EXIT=$bareCode"
if($bareCode -eq 0){throw "bare native failure was swallowed"}

$explicit='& cmd /c exit 9; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "native command failed"}'
& powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command $explicit
$explicitCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host "EXPLICIT_NATIVE_FAILURE_EXIT=$explicitCode"
if($explicitCode -eq 0){throw "explicit native failure was swallowed"}

$throwing='throw "intentional terminating error"'
& powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command $throwing
$throwCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host "POWERSHELL_THROW_EXIT=$throwCode"
if($throwCode -eq 0){throw "PowerShell throw was swallowed"}

$normal='Write-Host "INNER_NORMAL=PASS"'
& powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command $normal
$normalCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host "NORMAL_COMMAND_EXIT=$normalCode"
if($normalCode -ne 0){throw "normal command failed"}

Write-Host "REMOTE_COMMAND_EXIT_SEMANTICS_FINAL=PASS"
